limitations: This is a bounded semantic peer review of 18 changes in one cohort, not an overall graph-accuracy estimate.
H24 latest-time selection cannot reliably bind a result when extraction includes the entire study schedule; this is a retained limitation, not a fully corrected field.
Open-label alone no longer implies nonrandomization; true unrandomized trial detail can be lost in the controlled design category while surviving in prose.
Existing residual compound-kind metadata and domain policy issues are kept separate from new regression judgments.
